Terrible Experience – Rude Staff, Dirty Rooms, and Zero Hospitality

I had a horrible stay at this hotel. First of all, the room was not cleaned until 4 PM, which is unacceptable. When you ask for anything – be it water, towels, or housekeeping – be prepared to wait at least 30 minutes, if not more. The staff, especially the guy at the front desk, is rude, arrogant, and clearly not interested in guest service.

Their restaurant/kitchen serves some of the worst food I’ve ever had, and even after repeating specific instructions three times, they still got it wrong. No accountability, no apology – just blank stares.

To make matters worse, they have another affiliated property called The Picasso Residency- which appears to be a low-budget lodge frequented by questionable guests. I could hear shouting, abusing, and disturbing noises from nearby rooms. It honestly didn’t feel safe or comfortable at all.

The only redeeming quality is the location, but they are clearly taking advantage of that and doing nothing else right. There’s absolutely no hospitality, no warmth, and no basic courtesy.

This was easily one of the worst hotel stays I’ve had. Would never recommend.
